items.title: Lizzie Miles Interview, 1951-01-18
items.q: my favorite piece was Bing Crosby's brother Bob Crosby's the music box was a little bit of a song

ctx.x: You said it was about 1938 when your mother got married? 38 yeah

And you didn't sing after you came back to New Orleans? No I told you how I tried to get in and I couldn't get in so then I just What sort of job did you hold on here? Were you working then or were you just Yeah I went and a friend of mine had a bar room on Rampart Street it was during the holidays he said he wanted some extra help he asked me did I think I could do it I said well what is to do? I said serve some beer and some mixed drinks I said I did that at my house serve company you know high balls I think…
so all along even though you weren't actually singing the cabaret you did keep on singing on your own
